title: Grafana Dashboard Plan
description: A structured plan of a Grafana dashboard's panels, query functions, alert settings, and provisioning mode, so this skill's Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/grafana_dashboard_builder_audit.mjs.

metricType.description: The Prometheus metric type of the primary series being graphed.

rangeFunction.description: The range-vector function applied to that series in the main queries.

usesHistogramQuantile.description: True if any panel computes quantiles via histogram_quantile().

aggregatesByLe.description: True if every histogram_quantile aggregation preserves the le label (sum by (le, ...)).

hasAlerts.description: True if this plan includes alert rules.

alertKind.description: Whether the alert is SLO-tier (error rate, latency) or a hard-failure signal (service down).

alertForSeconds.description: The alert rule's for: dwell time, in seconds.

alertUsesIrate.description: True if any alert expression uses irate().

alertHasRunbookUrl.description: True if every alert carries a runbook annotation URL.

panelsSharingExpensiveQuery.description: How many panels (across dashboards) reuse the most expensive query expression.

usesRecordingRules.description: True if shared expensive expressions are pre-computed as Prometheus recording rules.

dashboardsInVersionControl.description: True if the dashboard JSON lives in git and is provisioned (Terraform/grafonnet), not live-edited.

variableIncludeAllEnabled.description: True if a template variable has Include All enabled.

variableCardinality.description: The number of values the largest template variable can take.
